proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Greater Invisibility's core mechanic is applying a named condition to a creature for the spell's duration — neither existing variant captures this. The apply_condition v4 atom already exists but has no OngoingOperation surface path.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: "invisible"
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently contains only "prone". The Invisible condition is a distinct SRD condition (Rules Glossary) required to represent this spell's effect and is mechanically significant (attackers have Advantage vs. the target, the target has Advantage on its attack rolls).

notes: The ongoing_effect family is the right structural fit: Touch range, one-target attachment, concentration-1-minute duration, single condition applied for duration, no save/no attack roll. Two surface widenings are needed: (1) add a new OngoingOperation variant { kind: "apply_condition"; condition: Condition } so the ongoing_effect tracer path can emit the apply_condition v4 atom, and (2) widen Condition to include "invisible". No new v4 atoms or families are required. Dhall/JSON/trace not authored because the types do not yet support this shape.
